name: Slap
description: Single short rockabilly-style slap echo; increasing amount raises send and optionally time within 55–180 ms.

name: Ping-Pong
description: Crossfed, alternating stereo delay, tempo-aware when possible.

name: Meltback
description: Warped, continuously pitch-wobbling echo feedback.

name: Rewind
description: Short reverse-buffer echoes with crossfaded boundaries.

name: Stutter
description: Hold and retrigger a micro-slice with density controlled by amount.

name: Doubler
description: Sub-50 ms humanized double tracking with subtle pitch variance.

name: Scatter
description: Scatter a sparse cloud of independently timed echoes.

name: Grain Trail
description: Delayed, time-smeared micrograins drifting behind transients.

name: Ghost Pre-Echo

name: Echo Collapse
description: Accelerating/contracting repeats in a safely bounded time buffer.

name: Plate Glow
description: Bright, dense plate-inspired reverb layer.

name: Spring Twang
description: Chirpy, dispersive spring-inspired splash.

name: Little Room
description: Short naturalistic ambience and close early reflections.

name: Endless Hall
description: Large, diffuse long reverb with bounded feedback and finite tails.

name: Halo
description: Pitch-shifted shimmer return above the original tail.

name: Gate the Sky
description: Abrupt rhythmic or envelope-shaped truncation of a reverb tail.

name: Backward Bloom
description: Reversed-envelope swelling reverb without pretending to predict future audio.

name: Reflection Dice
description: Randomized but deterministic clusters of early reflections.

name: Hold the Clouds
description: Soft-bounded frozen wash that sustains a snapshot; controlled decay and stop conditions.

name: Hide & Bloom
description: Duck reverb under incoming signal and make it swell between phrases.

name: Chorus Soup
description: Multi-voice, detuned chorus.

name: Jet Lag
description: Sweeping feedback flanger.

name: Phase Slipper
description: All-pass phaser motion.

name: Rotary Crisis
description: Leslie-inspired rotor/tremolo/Doppler movement.

name: Tremble
description: Amplitude tremolo (smooth through chopped at higher amounts).

name: Side-to-Side
description: Automatic left/right pan modulation.

name: Seasick
description: Pure vibrato with bounded depth.

name: Bell Ringer
description: Ring modulation at calibrated audible rates.

name: Warp Spiral
description: Slowly moving all-pass/comb hybrid with unusual stereo phase motion.

name: Filter Steps
description: Stepped modulation of a resonant filter independent of rhythmic gate effects.

name: Down an Octave

name: Fifth Dimension
description: Mix in +7 semitone voice.

name: Third Wheel
description: Mix in +4 semitone voice (optional scale-aware setting only if independently implemented).

name: Left Detune
description: Add a subtle negative-cent detuned voice biased left.

name: Right Detune
description: Add a subtle positive-cent detuned voice biased right.

name: Staircase
description: Quantized, periodically stepping pitch on a parallel grain voice.

name: Cluster Bomb
description: Cloud of closely spaced inharmonic/microtonal pitches.

name: Talking Metal
description: Moving formant/pitched resonator coloration (not just fixed EQ).

name: Dive Bomb
description: Brief trigger-aware descending pitch envelope on a wet-only branch.

name: Tape Heat
description: Smooth tape-style soft saturation and level-dependent compression.

name: Tube Sizzle
description: Asymmetric valve-like drive with harmonic emphasis.

name: Fuzz Monster
description: Aggressive fuzz with gated/sustaining behavior.

name: Redline
description: Hard clipping on a wet branch with safe post attenuation.

name: Fold It
description: Wavefolding distortion.

name: Crushed Bits
description: Quantization bit-depth reduction with optional bounded dither.

name: Broken Clock
description: Sample-rate reduction/hold effect, separately from bit depth.

name: Transistor Static
description: High-mid scratchy clipping texture (not a duplicate of Redline).

name: Half-Wave
description: Rectification-inspired octave/harmonic distortion with DC blocking.

name: Chewed Speaker
description: Limited-band overloaded speaker/cabinet breakup simulation.

name: Down the Drain
description: Sweeping low-pass darkening.

name: Thin Air
description: Sweeping high-pass thinning.

name: Telephone Portal
description: Mixable narrow band-pass coloration.

name: Missing Tooth
description: Deep movable notch filtering.

name: Scream Filter
description: Controlled high-resonance filter movement with stable Q.

name: Comb Canyon
description: Resonant comb filtering independent from the flanger's modulation.

name: Vowel Mouth
description: Animated formant filtering through speech-like vowels.

name: Tilt-a-Whirl
description: Broad spectral tilt around a defined pivot frequency.

name: Glitter
description: High-frequency nonlinear harmonic exciter, alias-managed.

name: Blur Vision
description: Time-frequency spectral blur/smear; document FFT latency and CPU.

name: Chop Shop
description: Tempo-synchronized amplitude chopper with patterned gates.

name: Beat Again
description: Host-tempo beat-repeat looper with hard maximum capture length.

name: Ratchet

name: Record Scratch

name: Dust

name: Pops
description: Infrequent bounded vinyl-pop transients, independently from Dust.

name: Slow Wobble

name: Flutterfly
description: Fast tape flutter with independently tuned rate spectrum.

name: Tape Hiss

name: Cassette Chew
description: Momentary slow tape drag/spindown bursts.

name: Pocket Radio
description: Narrow-band radio response plus tuned static modulation.

name: Digital Rot

name: Grain Dust

name: Twist M/S

name: Phase Roto

name: De-Correlate

name: Spin Cycle

name: Image Jitter
description: Random but smoothed spatial placement tremors.

name: Squeeze

name: Brick Party
description: Parallel extreme compression with independently mixed return.

name: Guillotine

name: Attack Jack
